title: Daily Product Sales Summary
description: Capstone: filter invalid overnight sales, compute discounted line revenue, aggregate per product_id. Keep rows only when product_id present, quantity in (0,100], unit_price > 0, discount_pct in [0,0.50], status=COMPLETED. Line revenue = quantity*unit_price*(1-discount_pct) round half-up 2dp. Output: product_id, total_units, total_revenue, txn_count. Write Parquet with overwrite.

problemStatement.overview: Filter → revenue → product aggregates; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: Bad rows and discounts must not corrupt the daily product summary.
yourTaskSteps: Read INPUT_PATH and filter to valid COMPLETED lines.
Aggregate total_units, total_revenue, txn_count by product_id.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py for the daily product sales summary capstone.
hints: Filter first — do not repair invalid values.
Reuse the discounted revenue formula from Derive / Aggregate labs.

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
Invalid rows excluded; product totals match expected/
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows
